subject: POC trial plan & model selection - next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T15:22:00Z
Subject: Follow-up + POC success criteria (recap from today)

Hi Sara -

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the POC/trial: 

Summary of needs:
- ACME wants an LLM-backed assistant for customer support routing and short-form summarization across English, Spanish, and French.
- Primary constraints: sub-200ms p95 latency for 512-token contexts, maintain <5% hallucination rate on canned QA, and cost target under $0.015 per 1k tokens during trial.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: p95 < 200ms for 512-token requests on Redwood Dedicated trial capacity.
2) Accuracy/Hallucination: measurable drop in hallucination vs current baseline (target <5% on our eval prompts).
3) Throughput: sustain 60 concurrent RPS for routing pipeline.
4) Multilingual quality: F1 > 0.82 on Spanish/French NER evaluation set (sample attached).
5) Integration: end-to-end demo with your staging data and our SDK within 3 weeks.

Model plan for trial (initial recommendation):
- Primary model: Llama-2-13B (quantized 4-bit) - balance of quality and latency for multi-lingual ops.
- Fallback model: Llama-2-7B (faster/cheaper) for low-latency routing paths and cold-starts.
- Tokenization: use shared tokenizer; we recommend prefix caching for repeated prompts.

Evaluation plan / roles:
- ACME (Sara): provide a 2k-row evaluation sample (CSV) with English/Spanish/French examples + success/label column (due EOD 2026-12-10).
- Redwood (Ben): provision Dedicated trial capacity, baseline perf metrics, and initial model variants (done by 2026-12-14).
- Redwood (Marissa / Eng): run automated evals, latency profiles, hallucination checks, and share results + recommendations (by 2026-12-18).

Next steps:
1) Sara to confirm success criteria and drop sample dataset (see attachment sample).
2) Ben to provision trial and share onboarding steps + credentials.
3) Schedule a 30-min technical sync with your AI infra & our eng (propose 2026-12-11 10:00 PST).

Attachments: acme_eval_dataset_sample.csv (sample format), redwood_poc_template.xlsx (POC checklist).

Thanks - looking forward to getting this started.

-
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME AI Team <ai-team@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC success criteria (recap from today)

Thanks Ben - this looks good. Quick notes: 

- Confirmed: Spanish and French examples are required; we'll prioritize Spanish.
- Latency target: we may need to relax p95 to 250ms for longer contexts (512 tokens) if needed - open to proposing optimizations.
- Cost target: happy to run both models if you can provide clear cost breakdowns.

I attached a small evaluation CSV (attached) with 500 rows as a first drop. We will expand to 2k rows by EOD Friday (2026-12-10).

We can do the technical sync 2026-12-11 10:00 PST - please send a calendar invite.

Sara
Product Manager, ACME Corp

Attachment: acme_eval_dataset_sample.csv (500 rows)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC success criteria (recap from today)

Perfect - thanks for the sample, Sara. Calendar invite sent for 2026-12-11 10:00 PST (30m).

Quick clarifications on the model plan and test harness: 
- We'll spin up a Dedicated trial pool with two model routes: route A -> Llama-2-13B-4bit (primary), route B -> Llama-2-7B (fallback). Routing policy: latency-first for routing inference, cost-aware for batching jobs.
- We'll enable prefix KV caching for repeated agent prompts and auto-batching for non-latency-critical jobs.
- For multilingual quality checks, Aditya will run bilingual evaluation suites (EN/ES/FR) and provide per-language confusion matrices + F1 scores.

Aditya, can you confirm you can get initial runs on the 500-row sample by Monday 2026-12-14? Also call out any additional data format requirements.

Ben

> On 2026-12-09, Sara Jenkins wrote:
> > Attachment: acme_eval_dataset_sample.csv (500 rows)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC success criteria (recap from today)

Thanks team - quick status update from Eng: 

- Provisioning: trial Dedicated pool request submitted; estimated ready time 2026-12-14 (confirmed).
- Model binaries: Llama-2-13B-4bit and Llama-2-7B images queued for deployment on the trial pool.
- Evaluation plan: we'll run the following automated checks on the 2k dataset when received:
  * Latency profile (p50/p95/p99) at 1, 10, 60 RPS
  * Hallucination detection on QA prompts (automated heuristics + manual spot checks)
  * Multilingual NER/QA F1 per language
  * Cost simulation using realistic batching settings

Deliverables and owners: 
- Redwood (Ben): provisioning link + onboarding steps (by 2026-12-11)
- ACME (Sara): 2k eval dataset + success criteria confirmation (by 2026-12-10 EOD) - partial sample received.
- Redwood (Aditya): initial run on current 500-row sample and will post preliminary numbers to the shared Drive (by 2026-12-14).
- Redwood (Marissa): full evaluation report and recommendation (by 2026-12-18).

Notes on multilingual model choice: 
- Llama-2-13B-4bit is our recommended starting point for balanced EN/ES/FR quality. If you see degraded performance on French, we'll spin a language-adapted 13B variant or add a lightweight specialist model for FR routing.
- Fallback 7B model will be used for ultra-low-latency routing and to reduce cost during peak. We'll include automatic fallback rules in the trial config.

I'll upload the POC checklist and the test harness scripts to the drive folder (link below). Please ping if you'd like different evaluation metrics.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/poc-acme

-
Marissa Cole
Engineering Lead, Customer Trials
Redwood Inference
